mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_document_chunk (document_id, chunk_index, content, page_num, image_urls, metadata) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{pageNum}, #{imageUrls}, #{metadata})

mapper.delete: UPDATE t_ai_document_chunk SET deleted = 1 WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_document_chunk WHERE deleted = 0 AND document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
SELECT c.* FROM t_ai_document_chunk c INNER JOIN t_ai_document d ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.status = 'ready' ORDER BY d.id, c.chunk_index
